description: Save a user-owned DSL template so it can be rendered later by ID. Validates the DSL with the catalog before persisting. Free (no credits). Optional `sampleData` (any JSON value) is stored with the template and returned whenever the template is fetched, preserving the template's binding shape. Optional `description` is a one-sentence summary surfaced on /templates. Returns { templateId, name, createdAt }.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what the template is for. Shown on /templates list rows and matched by list_templates `q`.

dsl.description: The builder DSL script to store. It is validated before saving. Up to 512KB.

name.description: Display name shown in list_templates results and on the /templates page.

sampleData.description: Optional JSON binding data to persist alongside the template. Returned by get_template.

name: save_template

createdAt.description: When the template was created, as a UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' timestamp.

title: Save template
